title: Piano Movers in Santa Clarita | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Piano movers in Santa Clarita, booked with the whole move: a crew of four, a $200 add-on and a plan for gated tracts, hillside lots and the curb.
heroSubtitle: A crew of four and a $200 add-on to your hourly move, with the curb, the gate and the drive up through the Newhall Pass planned before the truck leaves.

faq.question: Can the truck take the curb in front of my Santa Clarita home?
faq.answer: Only if the space is free when we arrive. City streets count as public parking, so a neighbor may legally leave a car at your curb. Park one of your own cars there the night before and move it when the crew calls to say they are close.

faq.question: What does the crew need for a piano move at Valencia Lakeshore?
faq.answer: A guest parking pass for the truck, issued by the homeowners association and valid for up to 48 hours. The association office works weekdays only, so collect the pass before a weekend move. If the association asks for insurance, we issue a COI naming it for $50.

faq.question: How does the crew get through the gates in Westridge or Tesoro Highlands?
faq.answer: You clear us with the guard or the association, and a day early we give you the crew leader's name and the truck's description to pass on. In Tesoro Highlands, tell us whether the truck should use a shared subdivision gate or the separate entrance of a 55+ neighborhood. Minutes spent waiting at a gate run on the hourly clock.

faq.question: Is a piano move in Santa Clarita priced differently from one in Los Angeles?
faq.answer: Nothing in the model changes: you pay four movers and a truck by the hour, plus the flat $200 piano charge and $30 for gas. The minimum and the drive time are what can differ. Addresses 30+ miles from our Los Angeles base raise the minimum from 3 hours to 4, and driving past 10 miles is counted at double time; the office tells you which rule your addresses trigger.

faq.question: Can my piano be moved today?
faq.answer: It can if a four-person crew still has room that day, so call 909-443-0004 as early as possible. Crews work Monday through Sunday from 8AM to 6PM, and the whole job has to fit that window.

faq.question: Can SOS tune or store the piano after the move?
faq.answer: No. We move pianos and nothing more: no tuning, appraisal, repair, storage or disposal. Let the instrument settle in its new room for a while, then call a tuner of your choice.
